name: MacEwan Law Club
tagline: Where MacEwan's future lawyers find their start.
intro: We are an enthusiastic collective of students providing networking opportunities for all students who are eager to jumpstart a career in the legal industry.
description: The MacEwan University Law Club: speaker nights, LSAT prep, networking and mock trials for MacEwan students curious about law.
joinBlurb: Membership runs through MacEwan's Campus Labs. It takes about two minutes with your MacEwan login.

standFor.intro: We strive to create a welcoming, all-inclusive environment that gives students the resources to prepare for their future in the legal world.

pillars.title: Explore the legal field
pillars.body: Open discussions about the work of lawyers, paralegals, legal assistants and more.

pillars.title: See legal work up close
pillars.body: Shadow sessions that give students a taste of day-to-day legal work.

pillars.title: Connect and prepare
pillars.body: Panel discussions, Meet the Firm, Mock LSATs and application assistance days.

pillars.title: Fellowship and leadership
pillars.body: A community where students support each other and grow as leaders.
